faqs.q: Do alligators live around New Bern?
faqs.a: Yes. The Neuse and Trent rivers and their creeks are alligator habitat at the northern edge of the species' range, and animals bask and travel throughout the system, more actively in spring and early summer. Never feed one, keep pets away from the water's edge, and keep your distance. Only an Alligator Control Agent under a per-animal permit from the NC Wildlife Resources Commission can handle one — report concerns to the Wildlife Helpline. Our crew covers the raccoon, bat, snake, and rodent work on the same streets.
